admin-2026008197.title_issue: 마약류 취급내역 기한 내 보고 위반
admin-2026008197.hook_line: 취급내역 보고 의무를 어겨 마약류제조업 업무정지 3일
admin-2026008197.summary: 식약처가 (주)휴온스에 마약류제조업자 업무정지 3일을 처분했다. 에스조피클론 원료·펜터민염산염·케타민염산염 주사 등의 마약류 취급내역을 마약류통합시스템으로 기한 내 보고·변경 보고해야 하는 의무를 어겼다.
key_facts: 위반: 마약류 취급내역 기한 내 보고·변경 보고 의무 위반
경위: 대상 품목에 조피클론 R-이성질체 표준품, 에스조피클론 시험연구용 원료, 펜터민염산염(25kg), 케타민염산염 주사 등 포함
처분: 마약류제조업자 업무정지 3일(2026-11-23~25)
근거: 마약류 관리에 관한 법률 제11조, 같은 법 시행규칙 제21조
checks: 마약류 양수·제조 내역을 마약류통합시스템 보고 내역과 날마다 대조하는가?
시험연구용 표준품과 원료의 양수도 마약류 보고 대상으로 관리하는가?

en.title_issue: Late reporting of narcotics handling records
en.hook_line: 3-day suspension as a narcotics manufacturer for breaching handling report duties
en.summary: MFDS suspended the company's narcotics manufacturing operations for 3 days for breaching the duty to report and amend narcotics handling records through the integrated narcotics system within the deadline, covering items including eszopiclone, phentermine hydrochloride and a ketamine hydrochloride injection.
key_facts: Violation: breach of the duty to report and amend narcotics handling records within the deadline
Timeline: items included a zopiclone R-isomer reference standard, eszopiclone research-use material, phentermine hydrochloride (25kg) and a ketamine hydrochloride injection
Sanction: 3-day suspension of operations as a narcotics manufacturer (2026-11-23 to 25)
Basis: Narcotics Control Act Article 11 and Article 21 of its Enforcement Rule
checks: Do you reconcile narcotics acquisition and manufacturing records against system reports daily?
Are acquisitions of research-use reference standards and materials managed as reportable narcotics transactions?

key_facts: 지적 1: 배지에 대한 관리상황을 적절히 기록할 것(시험실, 기타)
지적 2: 시험 판정에 대한 데이터 완전성 보완 대책을 마련할 것(시험실, 기타)
지적 3: 제조설비의 운전 적격성평가를 적절히 수행할 것(시설장비, 기타)
평가 결과: 지적(보완)사항 있음
gmpinspect-1Q73JiEyrIf.implication: 실사 대상은 비무균 일반제제 완제(단일) 제조소였다.
checks: 배지의 입고·조제·사용 상황을 배지마다 기록하는가? (지적 1)
시험 판정 자료의 수정·재처리 이력을 판정 전에 검토하는가? (지적 2)
제조설비마다 운전 적격성평가 보고서가 승인돼 있는가? (지적 3)

en.title_issue: Media records and equipment OQ to be fixed
en.hook_line: 3 deficiencies rated other, in the laboratory and facilities and equipment areas

key_facts: Finding 1: properly record the management status of culture media (laboratory, other)
Finding 2: put in place measures to secure data integrity of test judgments (laboratory, other)
Finding 3: properly perform operational qualification of manufacturing equipment (facilities and equipment, other)
Outcome: deficiencies found
en.implication: The inspected site manufactures non-sterile general finished products (single).
checks: Do you record receipt, preparation and use of each culture medium? (Finding 1)
Do you review edit and reprocessing history of test data before the judgment? (Finding 2)
Does each piece of manufacturing equipment have an approved operational qualification report? (Finding 3)

fda483-196287.hook_line: 역가 부족 안정성 기준일탈 조사가 340일째 열려 있음
fda483-196287.summary: FDA가 미국의 일반의약품 자체 상표 유통·재포장업체 Water-Jel Technologies, LLC에 Form 483(관찰사항 2건)을 발행했다. 안정성 기준일탈(OOS)과 부적합 조사를 제때 끝내지 않은 것과 안정성시험 프로그램을 따르지 않은 것을 지적했다.
key_facts: 관찰 1: 안정성 기준일탈과 부적합 조사를 타당한 근거 없이 제때 끝내지 않음
관찰 2: 제품마다 보관 조건·기간·시험 주기·시료 수를 정한 안정성시험 계획서를 수립하지 않음
fda483-196287.implication: 연고 제품의 역가 부족 기준일탈 조사는 340일 동안 열려 있었다(관찰 1). 회사가 연 부적합 조사의 절반 넘게가 156~681일 동안 열려 있었다(관찰 1). 포장 오류·수량 부족·누출 등의 부적합 조사는 1년 이상 열려 있었다(관찰 1). 회사의 안정성 설계 표준작업절차서(SOP) 5.9항은 제품마다 안정성시험 계획서를 두도록 정했다(관찰 2).
checks: 안정성 기준일탈 조사의 종결 기한과 연장 승인 기준이 정해져 있는가? (관찰 1)
열린 부적합 조사의 경과 일수를 정기적으로 보고하는가? (관찰 1)
제품마다 승인된 안정성시험 계획서가 있는가? (관찰 2)

en.hook_line: A low-potency stability OOS investigation had been open for 340 days
en.summary: FDA issued a Form 483 with 2 observations to Water-Jel Technologies, LLC, an own label distributor and repackager of OTC drugs in the United States, citing stability OOS and nonconformance investigations not completed in a timely manner and a stability program that was not followed.
key_facts: Observation 1: stability OOS and nonconformance investigations were not completed in a timely manner without adequate justification
Observation 2: no protocol was established for each drug product stating storage conditions, study length, test intervals and number of samples
en.implication: Low-potency stability OOS investigations for ointment products were open for 340 days (Observation 1). More than half of the nonconformances the firm initiated had been open for 156-681 days (Observation 1). Nonconformances for packaging errors, short counts and leaking product had been open for a year or more (Observation 1). Section 5.9 of the firm's Stability Design SOP requires a protocol for each drug product (Observation 2).
checks: Are there closure deadlines and extension approval criteria for stability OOS investigations? (Observation 1)
Do you regularly report how long open nonconformance investigations have been open? (Observation 1)
Does each product have an approved stability protocol? (Observation 2)

00ae76e635bb.hook_line: 기록 제출을 거부해 이 회사 의약품 전체가 수입경보에 오름
00ae76e635bb.summary: FDA가 원료의약품(API) 제조업체로 등록된 Tianjin Healthcare Medical Technology Co., Ltd.에 경고서한을 발행했다. FD&C Act 704(a)(4)에 따른 기록 요청을 거부한 것을 위반으로 지적했다.
key_facts: 위반 1: FD&C Act 704(a)(4)에 따른 기록 요청 제출 거부(301(e) 금지 행위)
당국 조치: 2026-08-25 수입경보 66-79 등재, 서한 수령 후 15영업일 안에 서면 회신
00ae76e635bb.implication: 약국 조제용으로 미국에 들어온 원료의약품의 수입 기록에 이 회사가 제조업체로 신고돼 있었다(위반 1). FDA가 2026-06-17 기록을 요청하자 회사는 2026-06-24 미국 시장용 생산을 중단하겠다며 제출을 거부했다(위반 1). FDA는 2026-06-25 재요청에서 수입된 원료의약품이 아직 유효기간 안에 있다고 알렸으나 회사는 다시 거부했다(위반 1). FDA는 판매나 생산을 멈추겠다는 의사가 규제 의무를 소급해 없애지 않는다고 밝혔다. 생산을 멈추면 21 CFR 207.29(a)(3)에 따라 30일 안에 등록을 갱신해야 한다고 안내했다.
checks: 규제기관의 기록 요청에 회신할 담당자와 기한이 정해져 있는가? (위반 1)
특정 시장에서 철수할 때 등록과 의약품 목록을 갱신하는 절차가 있는가? (위반 1)

en.title_issue: Refused records request, placed on import alert
en.hook_line: Refusing to provide records put all of the firm's drugs on import alert
en.summary: FDA issued a warning letter to Tianjin Healthcare Medical Technology Co., Ltd., registered as an API manufacturer, citing its refusal of a records request under section 704(a)(4) of the FD&C Act.
key_facts: Violation 1: refused to provide records requested under FD&C Act section 704(a)(4) (a prohibited act under section 301(e))
Agency action: placed on Import Alert 66-79 on 2026-08-25; written response due within 15 business days of receipt
en.implication: Import records showed APIs intended for pharmacy compounding entering the U.S. that declared the firm as manufacturer (Violation 1). After FDA's records request on 2026-06-17, the firm replied on 2026-06-24 that it would discontinue production for the U.S. market and refused to provide the documents (Violation 1). A follow-up request on 2026-06-25 noted the imported APIs were still within expiry, but the firm again refused (Violation 1). FDA stated that ceasing distribution or intending to stop production does not retroactively relieve regulatory obligations. FDA noted that under 21 CFR 207.29(a)(3) registration must be updated within 30 calendar days of ceasing operations.
checks: Are an owner and a deadline set for responding to regulator records requests? (Violation 1)
Do you have a procedure to update registration and listings when exiting a market? (Violation 1)

en.title_issue: Late reporting of drug supply records
en.hook_line: 10-day sales suspension for missing the supply report deadline, reduced
en.summary: MFDS suspended the company's sales operations for an injection product for 10 days for not reporting the product's supply records for the first quarter of 2026 within the deadline.
key_facts: Violation: supply records not reported within the deadline when finished drugs were shipped
Timeline: shipped 2026-02-11, reported 2026-02-13
Sanction: 10-day suspension of sales operations for the product (2026-11-24 to 2026-12-03)
Basis: Pharmaceutical Affairs Act Article 47-3(2) and Article 45 of its Enforcement Rule
en.implication: The sanction was reduced under general criterion 12(ha) because the supply records were reported within 1 month after the deadline.
checks: Do you compare the shipment date and supply report date for every shipment?
Is someone assigned to file supply reports on the same day as shipment?

admin-2026008195.hook_line: 프로포폴 표준품 등 취급내역을 기한 내 보고하지 않아 경고
admin-2026008195.summary: 식약처가 대한약품공업(주)에 마약류제조업자 경고를 처분했다. 향정신성의약품 프로포폴 표준품 등 116건의 취급내역을 보고기한 안에 보고하지 않았다.
key_facts: 위반: 마약류 취급내역을 마약류통합관리시스템에 보고기한 내 보고하지 않음
경위: 향정신성의약품 프로포폴(100 mg) 표준품 등 116건
처분: 마약류제조업자 경고
근거: 마약류 관리에 관한 법률 제11조, 같은 법 시행규칙 제21조
checks: 시험용 마약류 표준품의 구입·사용·폐기도 보고 대상으로 관리하는가?
보고기한을 넘긴 마약류 취급 건이 있는지 주마다 확인하는가?

en.hook_line: Warning for not reporting handling records, including a propofol standard, on time
en.summary: MFDS issued a warning to the company as a narcotics manufacturer for not reporting 116 handling records, including a propofol reference standard, within the reporting deadline.
key_facts: Violation: narcotics handling records not reported to the integrated narcotics management system within the deadline
Timeline: 116 records including a propofol (100 mg) reference standard, a psychotropic drug
Sanction: warning as a narcotics manufacturer
Basis: Narcotics Control Act Article 11 and Article 21 of its Enforcement Rule
checks: Are purchase, use and disposal of narcotic reference standards managed as reportable transactions?
Do you check weekly for narcotics transactions past the reporting deadline?

admin-2026008196.hook_line: 디히드로코데인 원료 등 취급내역 보고 의무를 어겨 경고
admin-2026008196.summary: 식약처가 (주)종근당에 마약류원료사용자·마약류제조업자·마약류수출입업자 경고를 처분했다. 디히드로코데인타르타르산염·덱스트로메토르판 브롬화수소산염수화물 원료 등의 마약류 취급내역 보고 의무를 어겼다.
key_facts: 위반: 마약류 취급내역을 마약류통합시스템으로 보고해야 하는 의무 위반
경위: 마약류원료사용자로서 디히드로코데인타르타르산염·덱스트로메토르판 브롬화수소산염수화물 수입 원료 등의 취급내역
처분: 마약류원료사용자·마약류제조업자·마약류수출입업자 경고
근거: 마약류 관리에 관한 법률 제11조, 같은 법 시행규칙 제21조
checks: 수입 마약류 원료의 입고·사용 내역을 시스템 보고 내역과 대조하는가?
마약류원료사용자·제조업자·수출입업자 지위별로 보고 담당이 정해져 있는가?

en.hook_line: Warning for breaching report duties for dihydrocodeine material and other items
en.summary: MFDS issued a warning to the company as a narcotic raw material user, narcotics manufacturer and narcotics importer-exporter for breaching the duty to report handling records of materials including dihydrocodeine tartrate and dextromethorphan hydrobromide hydrate.
key_facts: Violation: breach of the duty to report narcotics handling records through the integrated narcotics system
Timeline: handling records of imported materials including dihydrocodeine tartrate and dextromethorphan hydrobromide hydrate, as a narcotic raw material user
Sanction: warning as a narcotic raw material user, narcotics manufacturer and narcotics importer-exporter
Basis: Narcotics Control Act Article 11 and Article 21 of its Enforcement Rule
checks: Do you reconcile receipt and use of imported narcotic materials against system reports?
Is a reporting owner assigned for each licensed role (raw material user, manufacturer, importer-exporter)?
